prompt:
A sleek, modern 3-page editorial food magazine spread shown as three vertical panels side-by-side. Theme: “Crispy Cabbage Korean-Inspired Rice Bowl”.

Style: minimal, clean, high-end food magazine aesthetic. Use lots of white space, grid layout, bold sans-serif typography, and subtle color accents (green, orange, black). Mix sharp photorealistic food images with simple geometric diagrams and elegant infographics. No scrapbook elements.

LEFT PANEL (Page 1):
Large, high-quality hero photo of a rice bowl with crispy cabbage and a glossy fried egg. Clean title: “Crispy Cabbage Rice Bowl”.
Short subtitle below.
Sections:
- “Why It’s Trending” (short text blocks)
- Minimal “Flavor Profile” diagram (clean circular or quadrant chart)
- Small “Nutrition + Sustainability” section with simple icons

CENTER PANEL (Page 2):
Title: “Recipe”.
Structured grid layout:
- Ingredients list in neat column
- Step-by-step instructions with small numbered images:
  1. Roast cabbage
  2. Cook egg or tofu
  3. Mix sauce
  4. Assemble bowl
Include a clean infographic showing sauce ratio “2:1:1”
Use thin lines, arrows, and precise spacing.

RIGHT PANEL (Page 3):
Title: “Variations & Insights”.
Include:
- Four variation cards with small photos (protein add-on, spicy version, fresh version, fermented version)
- “Why It Works” section with minimal icons and short explanations
- Small cultural influence note (Korea, Japan, India) in a clean row
- A refined quote at the bottom in italic font

Design details:
Elegant, minimal, editorial layout. Strong alignment and spacing. Soft shadows. No clutter. High-resolution, professional magazine quality.

Aspect ratio: wide horizontal, 3-panel layout.
